description: Locate the tail-anchor transmembrane segment and the following C-terminal residues in each MFF ortholog by Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session()
ACC=[('Q9GZY8','Hs MFF'),('Q503U3','Dr MFFa'),('Q961C9','Dm Tango11'),('P91344','Ce MFF-2'),('Q19343','Ce MFF-1')]
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,
    'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
W=19; rows=[]; profs={}
for a,l in ACC:
    s=''.join(S.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta',timeout=30).text.split('\n')[1:])
    h=np.array([KD.get(c,0.0) for c in s])
    prof=np.array([h[i:i+W].mean() for i in range(len(s)-W+1)]); profs[l]=(prof,len(s))
    i=int(np.argmax(prof)); seg=s[i:i+W]; tail=s[i+W:]
    rows.append({'protein':l,'len':len(s),'max_KD':round(float(prof[i]),2),'TM_window':f'{i+1}-{i+W}',
                 'segment':seg,'residues_after':len(tail),'C_tail':tail,
                 'tail_net_charge':sum(1 for c in tail if c in 'KR')-sum(1 for c in tail if c in 'DE'),
                 'TM_like(KD>=1.6)':bool(prof[i]>=1.6)})
T=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option('display.width',220)
print('=== Kyte-Doolittle tail-anchor scan (window 19, global maximum) ===')
print(T.to_string(index=False)); T.to_csv('tail_anchor_scan_final.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4))
for l,(p,L) in profs.items():
    ax.plot(np.arange(len(p))+W//2+1, p, label=f'{l} (max {p.max():.2f})', lw=1.6)
ax.axhline(1.6,ls='--',c='firebrick',lw=1); ax.text(5,1.68,'KD 1.6 transmembrane threshold',color='firebrick',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('residue (window centre)'); ax.set_ylabel('mean Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy, window 19')
ax.set_title('A single C-terminal hydrophobic segment is present in every MFF ortholog including C. elegans MFF-1')
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
